reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa, revised by

 inspection &

and approved by eng. Tarek Youssef Head Sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power 
Station 2x320MW.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman

supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes.... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 jockey pump.

Isolate the electrical cable feeding the motor 
 of this pump.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 suction and delivery valves.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Suitable lifting device, feeler gauge.
Hammer, Torque wrench.
Dial indicator.

Check the main bearing 
temperature.
Check the pump for smooth operation.

Check all anchor bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if 
 necessary.
Check pump packing leakage and adjust as required.
Examine pump housing for signs of wear.

Examine bearings and couplings and make adjustments or replacements where 
 necessary. Give particular attention to bearing seals.
Regrease pump bearing with mobilux 2 ( 0.2 kg )
Check pump packing and replace as required.
Check bearing seals and replace as required.
Tighten all hold down bolts in pump housing.
Check coupling alignment.
Check impellers for wear and cracks.
Check alignment between pump and motor.

Technical Specification of Jockey Pump
Item | Jockey Pump
No. of pumps | 2
Type of pump | Centrifugal multi stage vertical pump
Pump model | THV 25-6
Manufacture | A Sterling Company -USA
Capacity | 25 US GPM
static pressure | 208 PSI
Setting :
 Start
 Stop | 180 PSI
 185 PSI
Fluid | Distillate water
Speed | 2915 RPM
Bearing type | Ball Bearing
Bearing size | SKF 6306-2Z /C3
Type of recommended grease | Mobil EP # 2
Motor power | 15 HP
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes.... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 jockey pump.
Isolate the electrical cable feeding the motor 
 of this pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 suction and delivery valves.

Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Suitable lifting device, feeler gauge.
Hammer, Torque wrench.
Dial indicator.
